title: Arrest and murder of Moshe Aharon Wietrub
summary: Moshe Aharon Wietrub was among those arrested, tortured, and murdered; the passage does not identify the perpetrator.
uncertaintyNote: The passage states the Gestapo demanded David Lieberman’s cooperation and separately describes arrests and murders; direct Gestapo responsibility for this specific murder is uncertain.
